hook_text: YOUR TOILET SPRAYS THIS EVERY FLUSH
short_title: Your toilet sprays THIS every time you flush 🤢 #shorts
short_description:
Scientists lit up a flushing toilet with green lasers: a cloud of tiny droplets shot up to about 1.5 m (5 ft) in roughly 8 seconds. Does closing the lid fix it? Not completely.

Sources: Crimaldi et al., Scientific Reports (2022), University of Colorado Boulder; Sassi et al., American Journal of Infection Control (2024), University of Arizona.

Synthetic voice, original illustrations.

#shorts #science #health #bathroom #didyouknow #factora
comment: Will you close the lid from now on? 🚽
